ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; surface is dominated by low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels with high-intensity pixels limited to localized scarring and barnacle clusters at the tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark pigmentation across both lobes with no large-scale contiguous white or high-contrast geometric blobs.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 115 degrees and a vertical depth comprising approximately 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency serrations along the trailing edge boundary; high-amplitude irregular textures at the distal tips due to biological growth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-sweeping convex curves extending from the median notch to the lateral termini.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple annular light-grey pixel clusters (approx. 3-5) visible across the mid-section of both lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple thin, light-colored linear streaks; one prominent diagonal scratch on the right lobe and several faint horizontal marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, high-intensity textured clusters (barnacles) located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
